title: Offline revision-bound UI live session and human-gate projection

binding.rule: Every event and validated input repeats the exact AR-0039 revision-3 binding; a changed binding is rejected.

human_gate.input: The UI may validate one bounded opaque selection for one request attempt.
human_gate.authority_rule: Validated UI input is not an AWG decision, AWQ acceptance, Coordinator transition, or runtime approval.

resume.safe_exit: Requires a prior UI checkpoint, exact prior-trace digest, and exact binding digest.
resume.decision: A validated input may be resumed only as the same request attempt and must not be replayed or re-bound.

failure_semantics.side_effects: The harness and checker perform no UI, network, provider, LLM, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, Git, process, or durable-state operation.

compatibility: Unknown schema or protocol versions are rejected; future versions require an explicit adapter and cannot reuse this evidence as live success.
limitations: A passing record is deterministic structural qualification only.
Live UI rendering, human presence, lease validity, authority decisions, and durable persistence remain unverified.
The private projection is a privacy boundary, not evidence that a real private UI session exists.
